test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A copper sphere of diameter 12 cm is drawn into a wire of diameter 4 mm. What is the length (in cm) of the wire? (Where л = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the copper sphere = 12 cm

Diameter of the wire = 4 mm = 0.4 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3) pi r³

Volume of wire = pi r² h

Since the volume of the sphere is equal to the volume of the wire:

(4)/(3) pi rₛₚₕₑᵣₑ³ = pi rwᵢᵣₑ² h

**Calculation:**

Radius of the sphere = 12 cm / 2 = 6 cm

Radius of the wire = 0.4 cm / 2 = 0.2 cm

Volume of the sphere = (4)/(3) pi times 6³

Volume of the sphere = (4)/(3) pi times 216

Volume of the sphere = 288 pi cm³

Volume of the wire = pi times 0.2² times h

Volume of the wire = pi times 0.04 times h

Since the volumes are equal:

288 pi = 0.04 pi times h

⇒ 288 = 0.04h

⇒ h = 288 / 0.04

⇒ h = 7200 cm

**The length of the wire is 7200 cm.**
